title: TrustBinding v0.1
description: A reputation update on the labor network's trust ledger (charter v0.1 §3 Trust event; LN-017). The charter's core operating statement: reputation is fulfillment history tied to real requests, NOT popularity or follower counts. THEREFORE: trust binds to a guild-scoped GKN Standing Vector reference (guild-knowledge-network) — epistemic standing, min-threshold, guild-scoped — and NOT to a raw scalar. LN-009: no universal candidate / global employability score. The `extra` bag MUST NOT carry a popularity scalar (popularity/followers/likes/score/global_score/…) — enforced in labor_contract.py; the feed/vanity model is rejected by construction.

event_type.description: LN-017: the trust ledger records these events with provenance.

standing_ref.description: A guild-scoped GKN Standing Vector reference. Guild-scoped by construction — a Master in guild:forensics is a Reader elsewhere until they earn standing there. This is what makes trust epistemic, not a global vanity number.

extra.description: Optional provenance annotations. MUST NOT contain a popularity scalar (rejected by labor_contract.py).
